name: Welcome To The Internets
aka: Welcome To The Internet, I'll Be Your Guide
look: A busy digital collage: a cat in a red headband holding a gold pistol rides a rearing white unicorn with a golden mane and a glowing red eye, under a pixelated sky with a rainbow, explosions, flames, dark smoke, a pixel castle and Nyan Cat in the corner.
use: Captioned as a chaotic welcome to online life, typically 'Welcome to the internet' plus an offer to be someone's guide, for greeting a newcomer to internet weirdness or for anything gloriously over the top.
examples: Please keep your arms inside the unicorn
Grandpa just made his first account
Hop on, we have a lot to cover
describe: cat riding a unicorn with a gun and rainbow explosions
kitten in a bandana on a rearing unicorn holding a pistol

origin: A digital collage signed by the artist sharpwriter, packed with internet icons such as Nyan Cat.
